about: SD-43 E2.4 (decisions.md §8): the rest and recovery rules the Bio page and the Biography tab print, one row per rule, each row's text the book's words with its book and page. `applies` names who a row is for: `all` (every character of `system`), `class:<slug>` (a held class), `race:<slug>` (the character's race) or `trait:<record key>` (a held alternate racial trait). A row with `record` is quoted from that corpus record's description; a row without one is the book's chapter prose, which the corpus does not hold (E0.5 receipt, 'Does not cover'). No number is computed from this table: it is printed as text.

rows.text: With a full night's rest (8 hours of sleep or more), you recover 1 hit point per character level. Any significant interruption during your rest prevents you from healing that night.
Temporary ability damage returns at the rate of 1 point per night of rest (8 hours) for each affected ability score.
To prepare his daily spells, a wizard must first sleep for 8 hours.
After resting, a wizard must study his spellbook to prepare any spells that day. If he wants to prepare all his spells, the process takes 1 hour.

rows.rule: Sorcerers and bards: daily readying of spells
rows.text: A sorcerer or bard needs 8 hours of rest (just like a wizard), after which she spends 15 minutes concentrating.

A divine spellcaster chooses and prepares spells ahead of time, just as a wizard does. However, a divine spellcaster does not require a period of rest to prepare spells. Instead, the character chooses a particular time of day to pray and receive spells.
The total number of rounds of rage per day is renewed after resting for 8 hours, although these hours do not need to be consecutive.
The Smite Evil effect remains until the target of the smite is dead or the next time you rest and regain your uses of this ability.
The total number of rounds of bloodrage per day is renewed after resting for 8 hours, although these hours don't need to be consecutive.
The pool refreshes once per day when you prepare your spells.
This damage can't be healed by any means other than getting a full night's rest, which removes all burn and associated nonlethal damage.
These gnomes recover 50% more hit points (minimum 1) whenever they recover hit points from rest.
